content.short: Anyone can create a Solana memecoin in seconds on pump.fun and trade it straight away on a bonding curve.
content.description: pump.fun made launching a token almost effortless. A creator names a coin, uploads an image and it is tradeable straight away on a bonding curve, so nobody has to seed liquidity, run a presale or hold a team allocation. As buying pushes the token along the curve, it graduates to PumpSwap, the platform's own AMM. The model kicked off the memecoin wave on Solana and keeps very high daily volumes. The app now includes a leaderboard, live streams, a trading terminal and holder rewards tied to the PUMP token, and works on both web and mobile.

resources.title: Pump.fun Ditches Its 'Use All Revenue to Burn Tokens' Policy
resources.tldr: Pump.fun burns about 36% of PUMP supply and now sends half of net revenue to automatic buybacks instead of all of it.

resources.title: Pump.fun Activity Craters 80% in Three Months as Traders Rotate into Perps
resources.tldr: Token graduations, revenue and Solana fees all fell sharply as traders moved from memecoins to perpetuals.

resources.title: Pump.fun Overhauls Creator Fees as Token Launches Hit Highest Daily Count Since September
resources.tldr: Pump.fun changes how token creators are paid as daily launches climb back to multi-month highs.
